name: Three Sisters walk
transport_note: Plan train and onward bus or walking access to Echo Point; travel is extra.
description: A short walk from Echo Point towards the Three Sisters viewpoints.

name: Fairfax Heritage walking track
transport_note: Arrange access to Blue Mountains Heritage Centre and pickup or extra return walking.
description: A gentle path towards Govetts Leap with forest and valley viewpoints.

name: Princes Rock walking track
transport_note: Arrange access to Wentworth Falls picnic area; station transfers are not modelled.
description: A historic track to a lookout over Wentworth Falls and the valley.

name: Wentworth Falls track
transport_note: Arrange access to Wentworth Falls picnic area; station transfers are not modelled.
description: A stepped walk past Fletchers lookout to the top of the falls.

name: Grand Canyon track
transport_note: Arrange access to Grand Canyon carpark; station transfers are not modelled.
description: A longer canyon circuit with rainforest and creek crossings; check heavy-rain advice.

name: South Lawson Waterfall Circuit
transport_note: Walk from Lawson station to Honour Avenue; allow over 1 km extra each way.
description: A forest circuit linking Adelina; Federal; Cataract and Junction Falls. Published lengths vary; this catalogue uses 3.5 km.

name: Gordon Falls to Katoomba walk
transport_note: Start at Gordon Falls; allow the extra 1.8 km from Leura station and onward transport at Katoomba.
description: A longer escarpment walk linking Leura and Katoomba; arrange the finish-to-start journey.

name: Cliff Top walking track
transport_note: Start at Govetts Leap or Evans lookout; return figures include retracing the track.
description: An escarpment walk between two Grose Valley lookouts with steps and forest sections.

name: Pulpit walking track
transport_note: Start at Govetts Leap; arrange trailhead access and check track alerts.
description: A return walk along the Grose Valley cliffs towards Pulpit Rock.

name: Lockley Pylon walking track
transport_note: Access via Mount Hay Road near Leura; check road conditions and vehicle suitability.
description: An exposed heathland walk to a Grose Valley viewpoint; carry navigation equipment.

name: Walls Ledge - Porters Pass - Centennial Glen circuit
transport_note: Start and finish at Centennial Glen Road carpark; check council track notices.
description: The specific Wildwalks circuit through cliff passes and gullies; includes steep terrain and slippery sections.
